buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC FOR SETTINGUP OF STRESS MANAGEMENT CENTRE:- 1. Seller should supply, installation, testing and commissioning of complete gym equipments. 2. All equipment should meet relevant ISI and international safety standards. 3. Seller should install all equipment at site without any extra cost. 4. Proper alignment, leveling and safety checks must be ensured. 5. Demonstration and trail run to be conducted in presence of unit representatives. 6. Seller should be responsible for minimum 2 to 3 years comprehensive warranty for all equipment. 7. Warranty to cover parts, labour and onsite service. 8. Preventive maintenance visit at least once in a every quarter. 9. Seller should complete the supply and installation within 30 to 45 days from the date of order issued. 10. Service support must be available within 24 to 48 hrs of complaint. 11. Seller should submit all manuals and warranty cards after installation. 12. Payment to be released only after successful installation and acceptance. .
